Ahri.watch: Keep minions between you and Ahri: getting hit by Ahri E Charm can leave you open to her full follow-up. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on the way back, so move out of its return path even after dodging the first pass.
Ahri.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Most of Ahri's damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, but it cannot reduce the true damage from the return of Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to handle an engage with Ahri R Spirit Rush, and add Morellonomicon if healing from Ahri P Essence Theft becomes a problem.
Ahri.fight: Trade right after dodging Ahri E Charm. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Ahri alone for bonus damage and Stardust. When Ahri R Spirit Rush is down or unavailable, you can close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Ahri.laning: Early on, keep minions between you and Ahri to block Ahri E Charm, and focus on the wave and Stardust instead of forcing trades. Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then clear them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. Do not poke with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light unless Ahri steps beside the minion wave.
Ahri.combo: Trade with Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, keeping your aim on Ahri while she is pulled in. For a full engage after dodging Ahri E Charm and with Ahri R Spirit Rush down, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Ahri.escape: Engage right after dodging Ahri E Charm.
Ahri.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger in mid game once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and you have one core item. In late game, each stack of Stardust improves your position.
Ahri.teamfight: After dodging Ahri E Charm or letting an ally draw attention first, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline for sustained damage based on maximum health. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow paths to objectives ahead of time to make it harder for enemies to approach. Use empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend to start teamfights with its wide area knockup and slow.

Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, her second dash will follow your escape, so watch for the shuriken before using Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. You cannot dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so save a way to respond to her engage.
Akali.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali deals mainly magic damage and Aurelion Sol has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to avoid one dash, and when building for more damage, include penetration to account for Akali's high magic resistance.
Akali.fight: Aurelion Sol is weak early, so avoid forcing trades. Fight back when Akali leaves Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack, and do not fly deep with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while she still has mobility available.
Akali.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then kill them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to stack Stardust. Minions block Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, so poke only when Akali steps beside the minion wave.
Akali.combo: For short trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Akali alone. To engage, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. Check whether Akali has any other mobility available before starting this combo.
Akali.escape: Then block escape routes with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Akali.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger in mid game once his ultimate is empowered and he has a core item. In late game, each stack of Stardust improves his position.
Akali.teamfight: Let an ally draw attention first or restrict enemy movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend before using Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. Keep dealing damage based on maximum health to the frontline, and do not use Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light too early: it holds you in place while Akali may still dash in. Before objectives, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in a path enemies must cross to make their approach harder.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits a minion, so dodge both passes even from behind the wave. When Akshan engages with Akshan E Heroic Swing, take care not to stand still using Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. If you are low on health and the targeting indicator for Akshan R Comeuppance appears, move behind terrain to block its shots.
Akshan.build: Akshan deals mainly physical damage and Aurelion Sol has low armor, so build armor first. Early on, use Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier if you need to avoid an engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Akshan.fight: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used, you have a chance to close the gap. Approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. Do not force an engage when a kill is unlikely, as Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight may stay on cooldown for a long time.
Akshan.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and farm them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to stack Stardust. Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so do not assume you are safe behind the wave.
Akshan.combo: To trade, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Akshan alone. If Akshan E Heroic Swing is down and you can fully engage, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Akshan.escape: Go in with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used. Then land Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend to make it hard for Akshan to escape.
Akshan.phase: Aurelion Sol is weak with little Stardust early, so farm the wave and survive instead of forcing trades with Akshan. He grows stronger from mid game once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and he has one core item. In late game, more Stardust increases the size and execution threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, so buying time favors you.
Akshan.teamfight: Keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline to deal damage based on maximum health. Deal damage after an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, and place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow entry paths ahead of time. If you have the Scoundrel mark, avoid facing Akshan alone and fight outside his finishing range.

Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania shows a white glow indicating her stun is ready, stay out of Annie's ability range. After taking the area damage from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, keep your distance from the summoned Tibbers too.
Annie.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Annie's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, then keep prioritizing magic resistance so you can survive one of Annie's combos.
Annie.fight: Fight after Annie P Pyromania's stun has been used. Hold Annie in place with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on her for extra damage and Stardust.
Annie.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to farm. Look to poke Annie only when she steps beside the minions.
Annie.combo: For short trades, use Aurelion Sol E Singularity followed by Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. If Annie P Pyromania's stun has been used and you can look for a kill, engage with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light maintained during Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Annie.escape: Keep your distance while Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. Right after she uses it is your chance to engage: approach Annie, who has no mobility ability, with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Annie.phase: Early on, Aurelion Sol is weak with little Stardust, so focus on surviving and farming waves. In the mid game, he grows stronger when Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend becomes empowered and he gets a core item. Late game, more Stardust increases Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area and execute threshold, so buying time works in your favor.
Annie.teamfight: Do not stand on top of allies when Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready or Annie is out of sight. Once an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Before an objective fight, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in a passage enemies must cross.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost detonates and stuns when recast, so dodge it from outside its range. If it hits you, leave Anivia R Glacial Storm before taking the empowered damage from Anivia E Frostbite. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your retreat, so choose where to fight carefully.
Anivia.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Anivia's healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Anivia.fight: Early on, prioritize waves and Stardust over risky trades. After Anivia Q Flash Frost has been used, hold her in place with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on her. If you and your allies trigger Anivia P Rebirth, look for a kill while she cannot revive again.
Anivia.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to farm and gain Stardust. Look to poke with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light only when Anivia steps beside the minions.
Anivia.combo: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light focused on Anivia. When committing to a fight, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, overlap it with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Anivia.escape: Engage during the window after Anivia Q Flash Frost has been used. Since Anivia has no mobility ability, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. When escaping, do not activate Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light during Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, so your flight speed does not slow down.
Anivia.phase: Early on, Aurelion Sol is weak with little Stardust, so survive and farm waves. From the mid game onward, as Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend becomes empowered and Stardust accumulates, time increasingly works in your favor.
Anivia.teamfight: Start fights in open areas rather than narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your retreat. Before an objective fight, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity at the enemy approach and start the teamfight with empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Once an ally draws attention or enemy movement is restricted, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and its return damage increases with missing health. If cursed, move off the straight line between you and Aurora; if your health is low, back away before it returns. Before Aurora R Between Worlds forms, decide whether to retreat outside its area.
Aurora.build: Aurora's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If you need to avoid Aurora's engage, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier; if healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Aurora.fight: For trades, hold Aurora in place with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on her. If she disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity at her expected destination and wait for her to reappear. Do not force an engage with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while Aurora still has a mobility ability available.
Aurora.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to clear them and build Stardust. Poke only when Aurora steps beside the minion wave and minions will not block Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Aurora.combo: For short trades, use Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, keeping the beam aimed at Aurora. If Aurora's ways to move have been used and you can commit to a fight, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light maintained during Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Aurora.escape: Do not engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil has been used. Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora R Between Worlds are also ways for her to escape, so look especially for the window before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back. During that window, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Aurora.phase: In the mid game, Aurelion Sol's power rises sharply once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and he has one core item. Late game, more Stardust increases Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area and execute threshold, so buy time to scale.
Aurora.teamfight: Pre-place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in a narrow passage Aurora must cross, and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Once an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, use Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. Aurora W Across the Veil resets when she participates in a takedown, so do not leave low-health allies behind when retreating.

Azir.watch: Move off the line where Azir W Arise!'s soldiers stand, and watch for the moment Azir Q Conquering Sands moves them and applies a slow. If you enter a narrow passage with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, Azir R Emperor's Divide can push you back, so engage in an open area.
Azir.build: Azir's main damage is magic and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. If you need to prepare for Azir engaging with Azir E Shifting Sands, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too.
Azir.fight: When a soldier is stationary or Azir Q Conquering Sands has been used, move around the soldier and target Azir himself. After forcing Azir E Shifting Sands, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Azir inside Aurelion Sol E Singularity.
Azir.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to farm. Try to poke when Azir steps beside the minion wave and you can hit him directly with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Azir.combo: For short trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light focused on Azir. In a full fight after Azir E Shifting Sands has been used, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Azir.escape: Right after Azir E Shifting Sands has been used is your chance to engage with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. If Azir places a soldier near a wall, account for the route he could take over it with Azir E Shifting Sands, and restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is still available, do not enter a narrow passage head-on.
Azir.phase: Aurelion Sol is weak early, so withstand Azir's soldier poke while collecting waves and Stardust. In the mid game, his power rises sharply after Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend becomes empowered and he gets a core item. Azir also grows stronger over time, but late-game Aurelion Sol gains area and execute threshold on Aurelion Sol E Singularity from Stardust, so keep scaling.
Azir.teamfight: Enter open areas from multiple directions so Azir R Emperor's Divide cannot push several of you back together. Before an objective fight, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity at the enemy approach, restrict movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Because Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light keeps you in place while you use it, activate it after an ally has drawn attention or you have restricted enemy movement.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also hits around the first target, so do not hide behind minions; retreat out of range. Reposition to avoid taking several missiles in a row, especially the third. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of standing in front of it.
Corki.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki's main damage is physical, and Aurelion Sol has low armor, so build armor first. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well to prepare for Corki engaging with Corki W Valkyrie.
Corki.fight: Avoid forcing fights early, and look to fight after Corki W Valkyrie is down. Hold him with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target for bonus damage and Stardust. Position first so you do not have to stand in the frontal area of Corki E Gatling Gun while channeling Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Corki.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then farm them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. Look to poke Corki with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light only when he steps beside the minions. If Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb hits you and reveals your position as you retreat, immediately create distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Corki.combo: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. When committing to a fight after Corki W Valkyrie is down, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Corki.escape: Right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie is your opening to enter. Close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, then cut off his escape with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. If a kill is unlikely and you use Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight to escape, do not activate Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light during the flight.
Corki.phase: When Corki W Valkyrie is down, use ganks and pressure to disrupt Corki's farming. Aurelion Sol gets stronger in mid game when Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend becomes empowered and you complete a core item. Later, accumulated Stardust increases the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity.
Corki.teamfight: Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in a narrow passage the enemy must cross to make entry difficult. Start the fight with empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the front line after an ally draws attention or enemy movement is restricted. Reposition to avoid multiple hits from Corki R Missile Barrage, and stay out of the frontal area of Corki E Gatling Gun.

Ekko.watch: When you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the area to avoid the stun and shield. Watch the direction of Ekko Q Timewinder and step aside from its return path too. If you can see the afterimage for Ekko R Chronobreak, do not overcommit to a chase even when health is low.
Ekko.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko's main damage is magic, and Aurelion Sol has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well to avoid Ekko's engage with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, his mobility ability is down. Hold him in place with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, watch the position of his afterimage and do not overcommit to the chase.
Ekko.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and clear them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to stack Stardust. Poke Ekko with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light only when he steps beside the minion wave.
Ekko.combo: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Ekko. In a full fight where Ekko's movement is restricted, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Ekko.escape: Your chance to enter comes after you avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak is down. If Ekko has just used Ekko E Phase Dive too, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and hold him with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Ekko.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger from mid game once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and you complete a core item. Later, the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity increase with Stardust, so buy time to scale.
Ekko.teamfight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and place Aurelion Sol E Singularity to stop his advance. Maintain Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light after an ally draws attention or Ekko's movement is restricted. Before a fight, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in a narrow path leading to an objective.

Fizz.watch: If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Fizz will use Fizz Q Urchin Strike to engage as the shark knocks you up, so place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in his path to force out Fizz E Playful / Trickster.
Fizz.build: Fizz deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier so you can avoid one of Fizz's engage combos.
Fizz.fight: Counterattack right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. Save Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend until then, and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target while Fizz has trouble escaping.
Fizz.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and collecting waves and Stardust rather than forcing trades. Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and farm them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. Look for a trade if Fizz misses a last hit with the empowered attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident or Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light focused on one target. In a full fight, restrict movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, follow with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while continuing to channel Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Fizz.escape: Do not engage just because Fizz Q Urchin Strike is down. Before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back, close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and use Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Fizz.phase: You become strong in the mid game once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is upgraded and you have one core item. Later, the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity grow with Stardust, so buy time to scale.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to your allies to draw out Fizz E Playful / Trickster, then focus Fizz once the ability is fully spent. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. After your allies draw attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the front line.

Galio.watch: When Galio starts charging Galio W Shield of Durand, his damage taken drops sharply. Do not unload your damage; move out of taunt range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when he winds up by stepping backward, and walk out of the area immediately when the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance appears.
Galio.build: Galio deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too, since Galio's engage can easily interrupt Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Galio.fight: Stop trading and create distance while Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand. After avoiding his engage, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. Before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back, an opening arises to close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Galio.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and farming waves for Stardust rather than trading. Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and clear them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. If Galio spends mana using abilities on the wave, push the lane to give him less room to influence other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Galio.combo: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then focus Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Galio alone. In a fight where Galio's engage tools are down, restrict movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, overlap it with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, and maintain Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light during Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Galio.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. If Galio R Hero's Entrance has yet to come back and you have dodged the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand, approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and block his retreat with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Galio.phase: Aurelion Sol grows strong in the midgame, once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and he has completed one core item. Later, Stardust increases the area and execution threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, among other things, so buy time to scale.
Galio.teamfight: When the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance appears, leave the area. Turn on Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light after your allies draw attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement.

Hwei.watch: If the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment hits you, you are likely to take follow-up damage. If the first ability hits, reposition immediately to avoid the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Watch for the eyes and ground effects Hwei places, and take a wide route around blocked passages.
Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Hwei.fight: Trade when Hwei steps beside the minions: place Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear, close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and fight.
Hwei.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and clear them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. If Hwei is behind the minions, do not force poke with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Hwei.combo: If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and place Aurelion Sol E Singularity. Then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while keeping Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Hwei alone.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so the moment after he uses Hwei E Subject: Torment is your opening to engage. Close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and block his escape with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, whoever leads the engage may be rooted or pushed back.
Hwei.phase: Your power rises sharply in the mid game when Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is upgraded and you have a core item. Later, the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity grow with Stardust, so buying time works in your favor.
Hwei.teamfight: Look for an opening after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used, and restrict enemy movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Around objectives, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity ahead of time in a passage enemies must cross to make their approach difficult. After your allies draw attention or enemy movement is restricted, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the front line.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can carry her through low-health minions to close the distance repeatedly, so do not leave half-health minions between you and Irelia. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped inside the barrier from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear; crossing it deals additional damage and applies a strong slow.
Irelia.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Aurelion Sol has low armor, so build armor first. If her engage is hard to survive, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge is a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the distance and fight. Approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. For damage, use Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep aiming at one target.
Irelia.laning: As minions get close to dying, take a step back to stay out of Irelia Q Bladesurge's engage range. Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and clear them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to build Stardust.
Irelia.combo: For a short trade, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. If Irelia's movement is restricted and you can start a full fight, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then maintain Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light during Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Irelia.escape: Engage right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge, especially if Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down. Watch for a chain engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge through low-health minions as you close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, then follow with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Irelia.phase: In the mid game, you become strong as Stardust upgrades Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and you gain a core item. Later, the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity grow with Stardust, so playing to buy time works in your favor.
Irelia.teamfight: When Irelia engages, deal with her first without overextending to target the back line. After your allies draw attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts movement, maintain Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. Around objectives, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity ahead of time in a passage Irelia must cross to make her approach difficult.

Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows you, and the area left by a Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame explodes again shortly afterward. If it hits you, leave the area immediately. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move away and break the tether before it roots you. Do not chase too hard while Karma E Inspire's shield and movement speed boost are active.
Karma.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Karma's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for the magic resistance.
Karma.fight: Early on, do not rush trades. Look for an angle with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light only when Karma steps out beside the minions. In a fight, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then keep Q on one target. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire's shield has ended, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Karma.laning: Trap minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and kill them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light layered over it to gain Stardust. Stand behind minions or out of range so you do not take free poke and let Karma use Karma R Mantra more often.
Karma.combo: For trades, use Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, keeping Q on Karma. To engage, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Q.
Karma.escape: Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down, you have an opening to engage with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. Check that Karma E Inspire's movement speed boost and shield have both ended too, then restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Karma.phase: Early on, Aurelion Sol is weak with little Stardust, so farm while enduring Karma's poke. He grows stronger from mid game once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and he has core items. Late game, more Stardust increases Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area and execution threshold, so buying time favors you.
Karma.teamfight: Keep your distance and wait for Karma W Focused Resolve to be used; engaging while it is available can get you caught. After the area shield from a Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire ends, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and Aurelion Sol E Singularity to restrict the approach. Keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline when an ally draws attention first or your R restricts enemy movement.

Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere interrupts the channel of Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light and grants a shield against magic damage. Kassadin can close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and then slow you with Kassadin E Force Pulse, so do not stand alone within his engage range.
Kassadin.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads. Build magic resistance against Kassadin's damage, and get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier so you can avoid one Kassadin R Riftwalk engage.
Kassadin.fight: After Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. If Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, you have an opening to close the gap and fight with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Kassadin.laning: Trap minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and layer Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over it to gain Stardust. Avoid unnecessary ability use near Kassadin.
Kassadin.combo: For trades, use Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, keeping Q on Kassadin. In a fight where Kassadin R Riftwalk is down and Kassadin Q Null Sphere is also unavailable, engage with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Kassadin.escape: While Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. To keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him, confirm that Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down too.
Kassadin.phase: In mid game, use the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and your core items. Late game, accumulated Stardust makes you stronger, but stay alert for Kassadin R Riftwalk into your backline.
Kassadin.teamfight: Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity on the enemy's approach in advance, restrict their movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Do not stand alone where Kassadin R Riftwalk can reach you. If Kassadin engages, hit him with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Leblanc.watch: If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice remains on you, the next ability will deal more damage. Back away and give the mark time to expire. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight to get out of tether range before it roots you. When LeBlanc comes in with LeBlanc W Distortion, check whether her window to return to her original position has expired before counterattacking.
Leblanc.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because LeBlanc deals primarily magic damage and Aurelion Sol has low magic resistance. Build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well to ride out LeBlanc's engage.
Leblanc.fight: Early on, focus on surviving and collecting Stardust instead of forcing trades. Once LeBlanc W Distortion's return expires or has been used, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. If you can secure a kill, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and continue Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Leblanc.laning: Trap minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and layer Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over it to collect Stardust. If LeBlanc disappears from mid vision, alert your team immediately and be cautious about leaving the wave to follow her.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc has exhausted her mobility options, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and place Aurelion Sol E Singularity. Then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while keeping Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the same target. Even in short trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and layer Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over it.
Leblanc.escape: Just after LeBlanc uses LeBlanc W Distortion is a chance to close the gap, but watch whether she returns while that option remains available. Once the return has expired or been used and the threat of LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains has passed, engage with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and catch her with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Leblanc.phase: In mid game, you grow stronger once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend becomes empowered and you have core items. Late game, more Stardust also increases Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area and execution threshold, so playing to buy time favors you.
Leblanc.teamfight: Use Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light after an ally draws attention first or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement. Hold the frontline in place and keep dealing damage based on maximum health; do not overextend into the backline chasing LeBlanc. Around objectives, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in advance in a passage the enemy must cross to make their approach harder.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard passes through a minion after hitting it, so do not stand in line with allied minions. If you are caught by the root from Lissandra W Ring of Frost and the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, you can easily take several hits in succession. Watch for her engage, especially while using Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Lissandra.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If you need a way to avoid her engage, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier.
Lissandra.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to gain Stardust. Avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard as it passes through minions, and poke with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light only when Lissandra steps beside the minion wave.
Lissandra.combo: After Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and place Aurelion Sol E Singularity. Then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while keeping Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the same target.
Lissandra.escape: Immediately after Lissandra has fully expended Lissandra E Glacial Path is your window to close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, the risk of being rooted is lower, so engage while blocking her escape routes with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Lissandra.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger in mid game once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend upgrades and you complete one core item. In late game, more Stardust increases the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, so buying time favors you.
Lissandra.teamfight: After an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow approaches ahead of time, and check whether Lissandra has used Lissandra E Glacial Path before engaging.

Lux.watch: Getting caught by Lux Q Light Binding makes it easy for her to land follow-up abilities, so bait it out and dodge it first. It binds the first two targets it hits, so do not stand in line with an ally. If a Lux ability hits you, leave her basic attack range to avoid the bonus damage from Lux P Illumination. Dodge sideways when you see the aiming line for Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads. Lux deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.fight: Bait and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. In a trade, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Lux alone to gain bonus damage and Stardust.
Lux.laning: Early on, focus on staying alive, farming waves, and gaining Stardust instead of trading. Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to clear them. Poke with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light only when Lux steps beside the minion wave and would be the first target hit.
Lux.combo: When engaging after Lux Q Light Binding misses, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and place Aurelion Sol E Singularity. Then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while keeping Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Lux.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility ability, so right after you bait and dodge Lux Q Light Binding is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Lux.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger in mid game once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend upgrades and you complete one core item. In late game, more Stardust increases the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, so buy time to scale.
Lux.teamfight: Approach spread out from your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity does not catch you together. Around objectives, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in advance in a path enemies must cross, then open the fight with the upgraded Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. After an ally draws attention first or enemy movement is restricted, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline.

Mel.watch: Dodge to the side of Mel E Solar Snare: its center roots you, setting up Mel Q Radiant Volley. When Mel W Rebuttal is active, do not rush to use your main abilities; use an Aurelion Sol E Singularity you have already placed. If Mel has hit you several times, watch for the execute even if you still have health. After leaving the fight, wait somewhere safe until the stacks expire.
Mel.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads. Mel deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.fight: Early on, prioritize the wave and Stardust over risky trades. After dodging Mel E Solar Snare, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. Mel has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight when you can catch her.
Mel.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to gain Stardust. Poke with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light only when Mel steps beside the minion wave. When you can pressure her safely, limit her chances to gain scaling stacks.
Mel.combo: In a trade, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light and keep hitting one target. In a full fight, restrict movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and place Aurelion Sol E Singularity. Then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Mel.escape: After Mel E Solar Snare misses is your chance to close the gap. Mel has no mobility ability, so approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Mel.phase: Mel is also weak before she completes her core items, but instead of forcing fights, safely push the lane or apply pressure to slow her stack growth. Aurelion Sol grows stronger in mid game when Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is upgraded and he has his core items. In late game, he grows stronger as he stacks Stardust.
Mel.teamfight: Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in advance in a path enemies must cross to block their approach. After an ally draws attention first or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep hitting the frontline with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. If you expect Mel W Rebuttal, do not rush your main abilities; use an Aurelion Sol E Singularity you have already placed.

Orianna.watch: Watch where Orianna Q Command: Attack places the ball and position accordingly. Stay away from the ball, as Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Early on, avoid taking consecutive basic attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Orianna's magic damage early. Choose Mercury's Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Orianna.fight: Early on, prioritize survival and Stardust over risky trades. Right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her, she loses the persistent defenses from Orianna E Command: Protect, giving you a chance to trade. Use Aurelion Sol E Singularity to restrict her movement and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target.
Orianna.laning: Minions block Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, so poke Orianna only when she steps beside the minion wave. Group the wave with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then clear it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to build Stardust.
Orianna.combo: For a short trade, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light and keep the beam on one target. In a full fight, restrict movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Orianna.escape: Look for an opening after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her and Orianna R Command: Shockwave's displacement has been used. If you can secure a kill, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and pin her down with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Orianna.phase: In mid game, your impact in fights grows once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend becomes empowered and you have one core item. Later, Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area and execution threshold grow with Stardust, so buy time to scale.
Orianna.teamfight: Track the ball's position more than Orianna's and avoid places where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity on the enemy's approach path and open the fight with empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. After allies first draw attention or restrict enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline.

Naafiri.watch: If the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you, keep your distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Her pack respawns right after she closes in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, so use Aurelion Sol E Singularity to restrict her movement and make space. Do not travel alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available, and retreat immediately after an ally dies to prepare for her re-engage.
Naafiri.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so prioritize armor and get health as well. If you need to survive her engage, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate is a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Naafiri.fight: Early on, prioritize survival and Stardust over risky fights. Right after Naafiri uses Naafiri E Eviscerate, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target to deal damage and gain Stardust. If you can secure a kill, approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while continuing Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Naafiri.laning: Farm behind the minion line without giving Naafiri an angle to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Minions block Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, so poke her only when she steps beside the minion line. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity on the wave first, then overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to gain Stardust from minion kills.
Naafiri.combo: For a short trade, use Aurelion Sol E Singularity followed by Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, keeping your aim on Naafiri alone. In a full fight, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light during Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Naafiri.escape: Do not engage just because either Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate has been used. Before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available again, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Naafiri.phase: In mid game, watch for Naafiri's roams and maintain broad vision. You grow stronger once you have Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend and a core item, so buy time to build Stardust into late game.
Naafiri.teamfight: Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity on the enemy's approach path. Once an ally draws attention first or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, maintain Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. Keep dealing damage based on maximum health to the frontline instead of forcing an attack on the backline.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby enemy, so back away from that wave. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside its portals and delay your engage until the silence ends. Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight cannot break Malzahar R Nether Grasp, so do not travel alone through areas where you have no vision while Malzahar can use it.
Malzahar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Malzahar deals mainly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only a large amount of health.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it with Aurelion Sol E Singularity before fighting. Trade when Malzahar steps beside the minion wave: place Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. Close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight after dodging the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void, when Malzahar R Nether Grasp cannot catch you.
Malzahar.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to clear them and gain Stardust. If Malzahar E Malefic Visions is on the wave, step away from the minions. When Malzahar has pushed the lane, look for a chance to engage with your jungler.
Malzahar.combo: After removing Malzahar P Void Shift, fight with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light during Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. Restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and pin him down with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Malzahar alone during Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Malzahar.escape: When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, dodge the silence before engaging. Do not go in alone with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while Malzahar R Nether Grasp can catch you. Look to engage once Malzahar P Void Shift is down and the Voidlings have disappeared or have not yet been summoned.
Malzahar.phase: In mid game, you grow stronger once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend becomes empowered and you have one core item. Later, Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area and execution threshold grow with Stardust, but the growth of Malzahar W Void Swarm is also permanent, so watch his summons while fighting.
Malzahar.teamfight: Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in a passage the enemy must cross. Once an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Do not go deep alone while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available.

Qiyana.watch: Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when its shockwave hits a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. When Qiyana holds the river element, retreat beyond the root range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If she disappears with the brush element, move into your allies' vision.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana deals mostly physical damage, so start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier so you can evade one engage with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity.
Qiyana.fight: Counterattack after Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity have been used, especially before Qiyana E Audacity is available again. Pin her down with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target to gain bonus damage and Stardust.
Qiyana.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and collecting Stardust from each wave instead of trading with Qiyana. Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to clear them. Do not poke with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light unless Qiyana steps beside the minions.
Qiyana.combo: When Qiyana's mobility ability has been used, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first in a trade, then overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. If you can secure a kill, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Qiyana.escape: Do not rush to engage when only Qiyana W Terrashape has been used; she can still escape with Qiyana E Audacity. Before Qiyana E Audacity is available again, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and block her retreat with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strong in mid game, but Aurelion Sol also grows stronger after his ultimate is empowered and he has a core item, so avoid giving up advantages in early and mid game. Aurelion Sol has the advantage later with accumulated Stardust, so build defenses and move with your team.
Qiyana.teamfight: Stand away from terrain with your allies so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent cannot explode against a wall. Once an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow approach paths ahead of time to make it harder for Qiyana to approach.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, stay away from allies until the mark expires. While marked, Ryze W Rune Prison roots and Ryze Q Overload deals amplified damage, so prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux.
Ryze.build: Ryze deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with Null-Magic Mantle for early survival and choose Mercury's Treads.
Ryze.fight: Early on, prioritize survival and Stardust over risky trades. When you have a chance to trade, pull Ryze in with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him. Use Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight to close the gap when Ryze's crowd control is down or he cannot use Ryze R Realm Warp.
Ryze.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then cast Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over them to secure kills and collect Stardust. Poke Ryze only when he steps beside the minions and you can hit him directly with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Ryze.combo: Start trades with Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, keeping the beam aimed at Ryze. In a full fight, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows instead of rooting. Close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, then restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Ryze.phase: Your impact in fights grows from mid game, once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and you have one core item. Later, more Stardust increases Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area and execute threshold, among other effects, so buy time to scale.
Ryze.teamfight: Before teamfights, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in a narrow passage enemies must cross to make entry difficult. Once an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp, you can interrupt its cast by stunning or knocking up Ryze with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend before it activates.

Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you on its return as well, Talon P Blade's End becomes a dangerous follow-up. If the first hit lands, move out of the return path. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, watch for a counterattack from stealth.
Talon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand physical damage and choose Plated Steelcaps. Build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to evade Talon's dash. Since Talon has relatively high magic resistance, include magic penetration in your offensive items.
Talon.fight: Early on, avoid forcing fights and build Stardust. If Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down and you have a chance to secure a kill, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, then restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Talon.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and clear them with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. If Talon roams, share his location and place vision along jungle routes.
Talon.combo: For short trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on one target. When fighting for a kill, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while continuing to hit with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is a chance to close the gap. Confirming that Talon R Shadow Assault is also down gives you a good chance to counterattack, but Talon E Assassin's Path is another movement option, so account for his escape route before going in.
Talon.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger from mid game as Stardust and core items build up, and the matchup becomes more favorable later. Respond to Talon's roams with vision and by sharing his location, buying time to scale.
Talon.teamfight: Stay grouped with allies. As Talon enters the backline, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Once an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend blocks movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline.

Syndra.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle for early survival and choose Mercury's Treads. Build magic resistance first against Syndra's main damage, but also consider enough health to survive the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.fight: Early on, prioritize survival and Stardust over risky trades. When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on her.
Syndra.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then cast Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over them to farm and collect Stardust. Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak place or throw effects onto the ground, so get boots early to give yourself room to dodge.
Syndra.combo: For short trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then cast Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over it. To start a full fight after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, restrict movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-defense tool and has a long cooldown, so right after she uses it is your chance to engage. Move out of the spheres' path, close in with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, and block her escape with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Syndra.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger from mid game, once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and you have one core item. Later, more Stardust increases Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area and execute threshold, among other effects, so buying time works in your favor.
Syndra.teamfight: Once an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow approaches to objectives ahead of time to make entry difficult. Move away from areas with several Syndra Q Dark Sphere spheres, and watch for Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.watch: If a sphere from Syndra Q Dark Sphere lies between Syndra and Aurelion Sol, Syndra can push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun Aurelion Sol, so move off that line. Syndra R Unleashed Power is more dangerous where several spheres are set up, and watch out for an execute when your health is low.

Sylas.watch: Watch the follow-up chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct more than the initial dash. If it hits, you’ll be knocked up and take a follow-up combo, so time Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight to dodge the chain. Move out of the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash before it explodes.
Sylas.build: Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier if you need to survive Sylas's engage. Add Morellonomicon if the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer becomes a problem.
Sylas.fight: Early on, prioritize the wave and Stardust over risky trades. After dodging the chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him. If you have a chance to secure a kill, approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and continue using Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light during the flight.
Sylas.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and cast Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over them to farm and build Stardust. Poke Sylas with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light only when he steps beside the minions; otherwise, focus on the wave.
Sylas.combo: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then cast Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over it and keep the beam on one target.
Sylas.escape: Do not engage just because Sylas W Kingslayer is down. After dodging the chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, use the window before it comes back to close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and block his escape with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Sylas.phase: Your fighting power rises sharply in mid game once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and you have a core item. Later, more Stardust increases Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area and execute threshold, so buy time to scale.
Sylas.teamfight: When Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, restrict him with Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and attack before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. Keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline after an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend blocks movement. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow approaches to objectives ahead of time to make entry difficult.

TwistedFate.watch: Once Twisted Fate W Pick a Card locks in a gold card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his basic attack range.
TwistedFate.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Twisted Fate deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.fight: Early on, focus on the wave and Stardust over trades. After Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card or Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, pin him in place with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him.
TwistedFate.laning: Only try to poke with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light when Twisted Fate steps out beside the minions.
TwistedFate.combo: For short trades, use Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, keeping the Q aimed only at Twisted Fate. In a full fight, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to engage.
TwistedFate.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger from mid game once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and he has a core item. Later, as Stardust stacks up, both the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity increase.
TwistedFate.teamfight: After an ally draws attention first or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow approaches ahead of time to control the path. If you see Twisted Fate traveling with Twisted Fate R Destiny and he is in range, interrupt it with Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns when you cross its edge. If trapped inside, move within it and wait for it to disappear instead of running into the edge. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground indicator and sidestep it. When health decreases, watch out for Veigar R Primordial Burst, whose damage increases with missing health, and move out of its range.
Veigar.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Veigar deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Veigar.fight: Early on, Aurelion Sol should focus on the wave and Stardust instead of forcing trades. When Veigar E Event Horizon is down and Veigar steps out beside the minions, pin him in place with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him. If a kill is possible, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Veigar.laning: Hold minions in Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to kill them and build Stardust. Position behind minions so you do not take unnecessary hits from Veigar Q Baleful Strike and give him permanent stacks.
Veigar.combo: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light aimed only at Veigar. If Veigar E Event Horizon is down and you can start a full fight, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Veigar.escape: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down, you have a chance to engage with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. If trapped in the cage, do not rush across its edge; save Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight for your escape.
Veigar.phase: From mid game, look actively for fights once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and you have one core item. Both champions grow stronger through permanent stacks late game, so keep collecting Stardust, but check Veigar's position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon before fighting.
Veigar.teamfight: After an ally draws attention first or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep dealing damage based on maximum health to the frontline with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. At objectives, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity ahead of time in a passage enemies must cross to make entry difficult. Check Veigar's position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon before engaging.

Vex.watch: While the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is ready, do not dash near Vex with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. Vex E Looming Darkness covers a larger area at longer range, so make a short sidestep when within its range. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you, move toward your allies to prepare for the follow-up dash.
Vex.build: Early on, withstand damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vex deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well to evade one engage from Vex R Shadow Surge.
Vex.fight: Look for a window after Vex uses the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom on the wave or for poke and the shield from Vex W Personal Space is also down. Pin Vex in place with Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on her for extra damage and Stardust. If a kill is possible and the fear is not ready, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Vex.laning: Hold minions in Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to build Stardust. Only poke when Vex steps out beside the minions and Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light can hit her directly.
Vex.combo: For short trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light aimed at Vex. If the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is down and the shield from Vex W Personal Space is also gone, restrict her movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and overlap it with Aurelion Sol E Singularity. Then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Vex.escape: Even then, delay engaging with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight if the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is ready. Once the fear has been used and the shield from Vex W Personal Space is also down, you have a chance to close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Vex.phase: In mid game, look for fights with one core item and an empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Later, more Stardust increases the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, so buying time works in your favor.
Vex.teamfight: Move low-health allies out of Vex's range first so a kill with Vex R Shadow Surge does not lead to chained dashes. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity on the enemy's approach and start the fight with an empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Once an ally draws attention first or enemy movement is restricted, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so avoid lining up with the wave and sidestep it. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, stop trading inside it and leave immediately to avoid the stun. Viktor R Arcane Storm interrupts channels when it appears, so be careful while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Viktor.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Viktor deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Movement speed helps you leave Viktor W Gravity Field before tenacity does.
Viktor.fight: After dodging Viktor W Gravity Field, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him. If you can secure a kill, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Viktor.laning: Do not line up with minions, so Viktor E Hextech Ray cannot hit you along with the wave. Hold minions in Aurelion Sol E Singularity and overlap it with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to collect the wave and Stardust. Do not poke with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light unless Viktor steps out beside the minion line.
Viktor.combo: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light hitting only Viktor. In a full fight, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while maintaining Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash, so dodging Viktor W Gravity Field gives you a chance to close the gap. Go in with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and restrict Viktor's movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. If a kill is unlikely, do not force Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
Viktor.phase: In mid game, Aurelion Sol gains a lot of strength once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered and he has a core item, but reassess trades when Viktor's augment status changes. Both champions grow through stacks late game, so keep building Stardust and use the expanded Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Viktor.teamfight: After an ally draws attention first or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep dealing damage based on maximum health to the frontline with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow approaches ahead of time to control the path. When approaching Viktor, do not stay inside Viktor W Gravity Field.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charge it, change direction and dodge sideways. A stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb can lead to follow-up damage, so watch for it especially closely. Start dodging as soon as you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane being cast.
Xerath.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.fight: Close the distance immediately after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used. For short trades, pin him down with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him. If you can secure a kill, engage with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light going.
Xerath.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and layer Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over them to collect Stardust. Farm while avoiding Xerath's heavy damage, then push the lane and call your jungler when mana starts running dry.
Xerath.combo: For trades, use Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. In a full fight, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight to close in, keeping Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light going without interruption.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used is your chance to engage. Close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, then pin him down with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Xerath.phase: Early on, survive Xerath's long-range poke without dying and collect Stardust. Aurelion Sol grows strong from mid game, once Stardust has built up and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend has upgraded. Late game, control passages with the expanded Aurelion Sol E Singularity to set up teamfights.
Xerath.teamfight: After an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Before an objective fight, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in a passage enemies must cross to make their approach difficult. Use the upgraded Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend to start fights across a wide area.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir E Tides of Blood slows, but minions can block the wave. When you see him charge it, keep minions between you and him or move out of range. Vladimir R Hemoplague increases the damage you take while infected, so reengage after its effect ends.
