Vladimir.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vladimir deals mostly magic damage, and Aurelion Sol has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Add Morellonomicon if his healing becomes a problem.
Vladimir.fight: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first. As it ends, pin him down with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him. If you can secure a kill, close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while continuing Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Vladimir.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and layer Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over them to clear the wave and collect Stardust. When poking Vladimir, wait until he steps beside the minion wave so minions do not take Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light first. If there is no opening, do not force a trade; prioritize farming every wave.
Vladimir.combo: After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is used, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then layer Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over it and keep it on the same target. In a full fight, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while continuously channeling Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to engage. Close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, then hold him with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. If a kill is unlikely, do not use Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight recklessly.
Vladimir.phase: In mid game, Aurelion Sol gains strength once Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend becomes available and he completes core items. Late game, more Stardust increases both the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity.
Vladimir.teamfight: Spread out so Vladimir R Hemoplague does not hit several teammates, and if infected, step back until its effect ends. Before an objective fight, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in a passage enemies must cross to block their approach. After an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts enemy movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his knock-up, stay out of range until the stacks expire. After he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, his return deals additional damage, so create distance before health drops. Yone R Fate Sealed moves him behind the last champion in its path, so before a teamfight, check that you are not standing alone at the back of your formation.
Yone.build: When Yone can dive in, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier so you can avoid one engage. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so consider armor and magic resistance together. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building a large amount of health alone.
Yone.fight: Early on, survive and collect waves and Stardust instead of forcing trades. After Yone engages, pin him down with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him. It is better to use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend after he engages so its crowd control can prevent his return from Yone E Soul Unbound.
Yone.laning: Keep your distance when Yone has his knock-up from Yone Q Mortal Steel ready. Only try to poke when he steps beside the minion wave and you can hit him directly with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
Yone.combo: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then focus Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Yone alone. When committing to a fight, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, layer Aurelion Sol E Singularity over it, then approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while keeping Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him.
Yone.escape: Do not engage just because Yone has used one Yone Q Mortal Steel. Look for a window before Yone R Fate Sealed is available again, after checking his other mobility options, then close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. If Yone engages in spirit form, use the crowd control from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend to prevent his return.
Yone.phase: In the mid game, once Stardust upgrades Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and you have core items, you’ll have more chances to fight. In the late game, more Stardust increases the area and execute threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, so buy time to scale.
Yone.teamfight: Space out from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave does not hit several of you, and do not stand alone at the back of Yone R Fate Sealed's path. After Yone engages, restrict his movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Once an ally draws attention or Yone's movement is restricted, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light going, and place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow approaches ahead of time.

Zed.watch: When Zed enters with Zed R Death Mark, he will try to build up damage before the mark detonates. Use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend to hold him and interrupt his combo. Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move out of the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light keeps you in place, so do not use it carelessly while Zed can engage.
Zed.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zed deals mainly physical damage, and Aurelion Sol has low armor, so build armor first. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well to avoid one of Zed's engages.
Zed.fight: Do not force trades with Zed early. Look for a window after he uses Zed W Living Shadow and the shadow disappears or he swaps positions, when Zed R Death Mark is also unavailable. Then pin him down with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on him.
Zed.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and layer Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over them to clear the wave. If Zed does not step beside the minions, do not try to poke him with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light, which the minions will block.
Zed.combo: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first, then focus Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Zed alone. After checking Zed's mobility options, if a full fight starts, engage with Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight while keeping Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light going.
Zed.escape: Even immediately after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, do not force an engage if Zed R Death Mark is still available. Before Zed R Death Mark comes back, once his shadow is also unavailable, close the distance with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight and hold him with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Zed.phase: Aurelion Sol is weak early, so avoid giving Zed an advantage and build Stardust. Mid game is Zed's strongest period, but Aurelion Sol also grows strong with one core item and the upgraded Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend. Late game, Zed weakens while Aurelion Sol continues to scale with Stardust, so fight alongside your team.
Zed.teamfight: After an ally draws attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend holds enemies in place, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline. Place Aurelion Sol E Singularity in narrow approaches ahead of time to make it harder for enemies whose health has decreased to move in.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, move behind a wall or an ally before you fall asleep, or Zoe Q Paddle Star! may hit you too. As Zoe fires and redirects Zoe Q Paddle Star!, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend to restrict her movement and disrupt her aim. A missed Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble remains as a trap, so watch out in narrow paths without vision.
Zoe.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zoe deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance, but it cannot block the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Focus on dodging the bubble.
Zoe.fight: For trades, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity first and keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Zoe. After Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down or Zoe has used Zoe R Portal Jump, close the gap with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, hit the spot she will return to with Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Zoe.laning: Group minions with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and farm with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light over it to build Stardust. Do not use Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to poke unless Zoe steps beside the minions.
Zoe.combo: In an all-in where you can kill Zoe, use Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend → Aurelion Sol E Singularity → Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, keeping Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light active as you fly. Keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on Zoe without switching targets to gain bonus damage and Stardust.
Zoe.escape: In particular, approach with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, then restrict Zoe's movement with Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
Zoe.phase: You become strong from mid game onward as you build Stardust, upgrade Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and complete core items. Later, more Stardust increases the area and execution threshold of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, so buy time to scale.
Zoe.teamfight: Look for an opening to engage after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, place Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend where she will return. Before objectives, establish vision and block the enemy approach with Aurelion Sol E Singularity. After an ally draws their attention or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend restricts their movement, keep Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light on the frontline.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him use minions to close the gap, so channeling Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light in place near a large minion wave is dangerous.
